stable.label: genesis-foundation-materials-0.1-integrated
stable.note: Matter Lab 0.6 and Materials Lab 0.1 are both integrated on main after fully green pull-request CI. Overall product remains unverified because live GitHub.io runtime behavior, a real WebGPU device run, and real iPhone Safari have not yet been independently exercised.

ci.simulation_test: PASS genesis matter 0.6 cooperative self-assembly tests
PASS genesis materials 0.1 granular sand/water tests

architecture: WebGPU state-derived renderer using read-only packed material state
quality presets from approximately 14k to 130k coarse cells
capabilities: gravity-driven coarse sand settling and pile formation
coarse water descent and lateral spreading
dry sand, wet sand, water, rock and erase tools
procedural WebGPU sand roughness and micro-detail

active_objective: Exercise the integrated Materials Lab on the live GitHub.io deployment and on a real WebGPU/iPhone Safari target, measure actual frame/simulation throughput, then choose the smallest justified optimization path. Add WebGPU compute or WebAssembly only if measured performance or capability requires it and compare optimized semantics against the CPU reference fixtures.
next_gate: Verify /materials/ on the deployed site, record renderer backend and real device behavior, benchmark representative quality presets, and do not claim WebGPU runtime or iPhone support until that evidence exists.
invariants: ChatGPT cannot self-certify its own changes
No critical project fact may live only in chat memory
Prototype experiments do not become product without a productionization gate
Tyler is not the build system or log courier
UNKNOWN must never silently become PASS
Infrastructure must not be described as simulation capability
CI PASS does not imply live deployment PASS or iPhone PASS
Rendering consumes simulation state and must not secretly become simulation logic
WebGPU rendering does not imply GPU-compute physics
Coarse sand cells must not be described as literal micron-scale grains
Toy moisture cohesion must not be described as validated capillary/geotechnical physics
Water local-move rules must not be described as Navier-Stokes or SPH
Matter Lab 0.6 remains independently available after Materials Lab integration
The all-matter dream must not be silently downgraded to the current 2D model
